name: Tri-Mip Encoding
definition: A method to model the pre-filtered 3D feature space by factorizing it into three orthogonal 2D mipmaps, enabling efficient area sampling for anti-aliased rendering.
summary: Tri-Mip Encoding models 3D space using three orthogonal 2D mipmaps to enable efficient, anti-aliased area sampling, distinguishing itself from static feature planes by explicitly modeling pre-filtered features for coherence across resolutions.
